outcome: effectiveness of ESM-UBT in managing PPH
cohort: The study involved 26 pregnant women who experienced PPH unresponsive to initial medical management, out of a total of 1,359 deliveries.
finding: ESM-UBT was successful in controlling PPH in 85% of cases, with a combined success rate of 96.15% when used with other interventions like devascularization and compression sutures, resulting in no maternal deaths.
